caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL.) under different settings of the “Numbers of Sub-Dims,” showing two model curves for comparison. The x-axis is labeled “Numbers of Sub-Dims” on a linear scale with discrete tick values at 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256 (the 16 and 32 tick labels appear closely spaced and visually crowded), spanning from 16 to 256. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale ranging from 9.5 to 12.5, with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. One line corresponds to “Transformer” and is drawn as a red dashed horizontal line, staying essentially constant at about 11.6 across all sub-dimension values. The other line corresponds to “MoHD” and is drawn as a blue solid line with square markers, starting near 10.45 at 16 sub-dims, rising to about 10.50 at 32 and about 10.55 at 64, reaching roughly 10.67 at 128, and then ending slightly lower at about 10.63 at 256.
